map.溺死诊断依据硅藻检验：溺死时硅藻可经循环进入肺、肝、肾、骨髓等内脏，且各器官检出: The drowning diagnosis rests on diatom examination: during drowning, diatoms can enter the lungs, liver, kidney and bone marrow through the circulation, and the species found in each organ should match the water sample at the scene. Key decision points are a diatom load in the lungs significantly higher than in other organs, detection in at least 2 organs, species matching the water at the drowning site, and the diatom count reaching the threshold (commonly more than 20 per 10 g of tissue). Meeting several criteria supports drowning; detection only in the lungs suggests post-mortem immersion, so the case circumstances and autopsy must be judged together.

map.硅藻种类与水样一致性比对: Comparing Diatom Species with the Water Sample
map.取肝、肺、肾、骨髓等脏器消化后镜检硅藻：生前溺死时溺液经肺入体循环，多脏器（尤其: Digest the liver, lung, kidney and bone marrow and examine them microscopically for diatoms. In antemortem drowning the inhaled water passes through the lungs into the systemic circulation, so diatoms are found in multiple organs (especially liver, kidney and bone marrow) with species consistent with the scene water sample. In post-mortem immersion, diatoms appear only locally in the lung or trachea and other organs test negative.
map.肝硅藻 15 个、肺 12 个、肾 8 个均阳性，检出种类与水样 3 种一致，骨: Liver 15, lung 12 and kidney 8 all positive, with 3 species matching the water sample and bone marrow also positive, supports an antemortem drowning diagnosis. If only the lung is positive while liver, kidney and bone marrow are negative and species do not match, this leans toward post-mortem immersion.
map.硅藻阴性就能排除溺死吗？: Can a negative diatom test rule out drowning?
map.不能。清水中硅藻少、腐败破坏、检验方法灵敏度不足均可致假阴性；应结合肺水肿、呼吸: No. Few diatoms in clear water, decomposition and insufficient test sensitivity can all cause false negatives. Combine it with pulmonary oedema and blood-stained respiratory foam; a negative result does not absolutely exclude drowning.
map.为什么看肝/肾/骨髓而不是只看肺？: Why look at liver, kidney and bone marrow rather than only lung?
map.肺直接接触溺液易假阳性，而肝/肾/骨髓硅藻需经体循环运输，阳性更具「生前吸入」特: The lung directly contacts the inhaled water and is prone to false positives, whereas diatoms in liver, kidney and bone marrow must travel through the systemic circulation, so a positive result is more specific for antemortem aspiration and is key to the multi-organ consistency judgement.
map.硅藻检测法是法医学溺死诊断的重要方法，原理是生前吸入溺液后硅藻经肺进入体循环: The diatom test is an important method for the forensic drowning diagnosis, based on the principle that after antemortem aspiration of water the diatoms enter the systemic circulation through the lungs
map.肺内检出大量硅藻(≥10个/10g)且种类≥2种支持溺死诊断: A large diatom load in the lungs (at least 10 per 10g) with at least 2 species supports a drowning diagnosis
map.骨髓中检出硅藻是生前溺死的强力证据，因死后污染难以到达骨髓: Finding diatoms in bone marrow is strong evidence of antemortem drowning, since post-mortem contamination cannot easily reach the marrow
map.硅藻种类应与 suspected 溺水水体种类比对，一致性越高诊断越可靠: Diatom species should be compared with the suspected drowning water body; higher consistency means a more reliable diagnosis
map.腐败尸体或高度腐解组织可能影响检测，酸消化法需彻底破坏有机质: Decomposed bodies or highly decomposed tissue can affect the test; the acid digestion method must thoroughly break down organic matter
